item.title: Khaleda Zia may require treatment abroad, but not yet fit to travel: Fakhrul
item.description: BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on Saturday said that although the medical board treating party Chairperson and former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia believes she may need treatment abroad, her condition is currently too unstable for travel.“At this moment, she is not fit to be moved overseas,” Fakhrul said
